info.name: pdf-shop-worker
info.description:
Simulates a GCP Pub/Sub push notification for a Cloud Storage document-created event, so worker's POST / can be triggered manually during local testing without real GCP infrastructure.

Before sending the first request: run `nx serve pdf-shop-worker`, create a document via the website's /create page, and set the `documentId` variable below to the id from that document's created record (visible in the /purchase URL after creating a spec). The request's `message.data` field is included only for structural realism — worker's current handler reads just `message.attributes.eventType` and `message.attributes.objectId`, so `data` does not need to stay in sync with `documentId`.

The other two requests need no setup — they exercise worker's two failure paths directly and use fixed, self-contained ids.

request.description: Expected: 201, and a real created/{{documentId}}.json must already exist at PDF_SHOP_DATA_DIR for generation to actually succeed (check for generated/{{documentId}}.txt and .json afterward).

item.name: Simulate a notification for a non-created object (ignored)

request.description: objectId doesn't match the created/*.json prefix worker filters on, so this is acknowledged but ignored — no setup required. Expected: 201, with a 'Unprocessable request received' warn log on the worker side.

item.name: Simulate a notification for a document with no order record (bad input)

request.description: objectId matches the created/*.json shape worker expects, but no such record exists on disk (no setup required — this id is intentionally never created), so generateDocument fails to find it. Expected: 500, with a 'Failed to generate document' error log on the worker side.
